lines.text: Jesus calls the Twelve together, gives them power over all demons and diseases, and sends them to proclaim the kingdom of God.
Jesus tells them to take nothing for the journey: no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no second tunic.
Jesus tells them to stay in whatever house they enter, and to shake the dust off their feet if a town rejects them.

wrong_details.wrong: stay in whatever house they enter
wrong_details.true: stay there until you leave that area

lines.text: The Twelve set out and go straight to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere.
Herod the tetrarch is perplexed by reports that John rose, Elijah appeared, or a prophet arose, and he keeps trying to see Jesus.
